paragraphs.text: Danhelm was a dwarven general and leader of the dwarven army in Sarpadia at the time of the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires on Dominaria .
When an orc - goblin alliance attacked Gurn Keep , many dwarves fell at their sheer number. The general, fighting with his men to defend their land, was killed from behind by an orcish spear.
